name: 120-cell (Red Queen)
scale: corners = centres of the 600-cell's cells (#63 source, radius 2)

checks.check: corners on one sphere, all edges one length, 4 edges at every corner
every cell: 20 corners, 30 edges, 12 pentagons (each pentagon a 5-cycle of edges)
the four directions = the 600-cell's cell-, triangle-, edge- and vertex-first directions (exactly parallel)
one pattern per gap: in every gap the cuts at 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 have identical faces (as sets of crossed edges)
inside every gap each slice face is the cross-section of exactly one dodecahedral cell, one face per cell cut
every corner in the cut and every edge crossing is a vertex of its slice
slice faces have 3 to 10 sides (cross-sections of dodecahedra)
the 120-cell is centrally symmetric (-p is a corner for every corner p)
each 120-cell shadow is polar to the 600-cell's central slice in the same direction (V, E, F swap with F, E, V)
each 120-cell central slice is polar to the 600-cell's shadow in the same direction
every shadow: front cells tile it exactly once and back cells tile it exactly once (exact volume), side-on cells flat
front and back cell counts equal in every direction
every side-on cell flattens onto one face of its shadow's hull

the uniform-solid slices (all faces regular, one edge, one vertex type, inscribed, uniform dihedral count) are exactly: cell-first rhombicosidodecahedron, truncated icosahedron, icosidodecahedron, truncated dodecahedron, regular dodecahedra; vertex-first regular tetrahedra; edge-first triangular prism; face-first pentagonal prism

the all-pentagon slices are exactly the 3 cell-first slices from height 5/4 + 9/16√5 to the tip, all regular dodecahedra: the tip one is the cell (edge² 1/4), the one at 5/4 + 9/16√5 has edge φ times the cell's

in the gaps the truncated icosahedron and truncated dodecahedron are uniform only at mid-gap (two edge lengths at 1/4 and 3/4); only the gaps below the cell-first tip (regular dodecahedron) and the vertex-first tip (regular tetrahedron) keep a uniform form throughout
